b:
Though ages pass,
though epics fade,
she is the dream angel
who never leaves
my imagination

Seeing
the darkness of her hair,
even the koel will ask for another boon;
even
her idle smiles
recite the Vedas of Brahma

Drops of time
from a descended rain cloud
wait like a pearl
in the shell
of her dimple

I reached out
to touch the scattered pearl,
and my dream broke
note: The koel is a black bird; its "other boon" would be hair as dark as hers. Brahma, the four-faced creator, is said to have given the Vedas.
